name: arxiv_lookup
description: Search arXiv or fetch papers by id through the arXiv API and return each entry's id and version, title, authors and affiliations, abstract, submission and update dates, categories, comment, journal reference, DOI and abs/PDF links. Ids in new (1706.03762v7) or old (hep-th/9711200) form, or a query in arXiv syntax (ti:, au:, abs:, cat:, AND/OR/ANDNOT), up to 50 results. One HTTPS request per call, 15 s timeout, no key; pass the Atom body as response to parse it offline.

id_list.description: arXiv ids, with or without version or arXiv: prefix

search_query.description: arXiv query syntax, e.g. au:vaswani AND ti:attention

max_results.description: Default 10, or the number of ids when only id_list is given

response.description: The exact Atom text the API returned (offline or cached use); no request is made

catalog.source: arXiv API User's Manual (https://info.arxiv.org/help/api/user-manual.html): query interface at https://export.arxiv.org/api/query, Atom 1.0 response with the arxiv and opensearch extensions, terms of use asking for one request every three seconds
